## Description

A STEP file containing `PRESENTATION_LAYER_ASSIGNMENT` records with layer names is read; the resulting XCAF document has no layer attributes — the assignment records were parsed but their target layer name was discarded.

## Reproducer recipe

STEP file with `PRESENTATION_LAYER_ASSIGNMENT( 'layer1','',(#100,#101))` referencing two faces. After import, layer attribute on the faces is missing.

## Expected kernel behavior

layer-assignment entities populate XCAF layer table; faces / edges retain layer-name metadata.

## Notes

Provenance tier: runtime-only — kernel imports STEP but loses layer info; defect is in the importer, not byte-encodable.
